name: smart-flint
description: Self-hosted SMART on FHIR launch, credential and interoperability bridge

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,console,ehr,patient,cds,fhir -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue,gray "npm run dev -w @smart-flint/server" "npm run dev -w @smart-flint/console" "npm run dev -w @smart-flint/mock-ehr" "npm run dev -w @smart-flint/sample-patient" "npm run dev -w @smart-flint/sample-cds" "npm run dev -w @smart-flint/sample-fhir"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -k -n server,console,ehr -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @smart-flint/server" "npm run dev -w @smart-flint/console" "npm run dev -w @smart-flint/mock-ehr"
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @smart-flint/console && npm run typecheck -w @smart-flint/sample-patient
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build -w @smart-flint/contracts && npm run build -w @smart-flint/sdk
scripts.security:check: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run notices:check && vitest run tests/security.test.ts tests/admin-auth.test.ts tests/admin-access.test.ts tests/admin-local-auth.test.ts tests/operations-health.test.ts
